# KaTeX

This directory contains KaTeX 0.18.4 and its MIT license.

The minified distribution and license were retrieved on 2026-10-04 from:

https://github.com/anthropics/fermats-last-theorem/tree/main/html/assets/vendor/katex

Upstream project: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX

The proof wiki requests native MathML output only. It does not load KaTeX CSS,
font files, external scripts, or any network resource. The generated site
manifest records SHA-256 hashes of these exact files.
